title: MultiFlow: Vision-Driven Multimodal fMRI Encoding via Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.15339v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current fMRI encoding models frame prediction as deterministic regression, yet identical stimuli evoke a distribution of neural responses (arising from physiological noise, hemodynamic variability, and cognitive fluctuations) that a single point estimate cannot capture. This work introduces MultiFlow, a generative fMRI encoding framework based on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) and a formulation termed Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching (SISFM). SISFM generalises CFM by conditioning the source distribution on the stimulus: a learnable temporal convolution shapes the source mean with an HRF-length receptive field, while a variance head shrinks its scale, shortening the expected transport path. translated_title: MultiFlow：基于刺激信息源流匹配的视觉驱动多模态fMRI编码
translated_abstract: 当前的fMRI编码模型将预测任务视为确定性回归，然而相同的刺激会引发一个神经响应分布（由生理噪声、血流动力学变异性和认知波动产生），这是单一点估计无法捕捉的。本工作提出了MultiFlow，一个基于条件流匹配的生成式fMRI编码框架，并提出了称为刺激信息源流匹配（SISFM）的公式化方法。SISFM通过将源分布以刺激为条件来泛化条件流匹配：一个具有HRF长度感受野的可学习时间卷积塑造源均值，同时方差头缩小其尺度，从而缩短预期的传输路径。SISFM通过一个参数化速度场的扩散Transformer（DiT-X）解码器来实现，包含子层注意力残差、十个冻结的视觉、音频、语言和视听骨干网络的异构融合，以及每个受试者的Yeo-（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了MultiFlow生成式fMRI编码框架，通过刺激信息源流匹配（SISFM）将源分布以刺激为条件，从而建模神经响应的分布特性而非单点估计。
